hook.name: Infect
hook.description: ERC-20 memecoin and Uniswap v4 hook that runs a PvP infection game: every buy/sell charges an ETH-denominated tax (2% on buys and clean sells, 7% on infected-wallet sells), distributed to all holders by balance. Users lock tokens to infect wallets and earn a share of those wallets' sell taxes; the hook skims fees via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta overrides with the LP fee forced to zero.
